Interesting! The `heapframe` structure has `ovector[2]` - only 2 elements. But the code at line 819 does:

```c
memcpy(ovector+2, Fovector, (oveccount - 1) * 2 * sizeof(PCRE2_SIZE));
```

This copies `(oveccount - 1) * 2` PCRE2_SIZE values from `Fovector` (which is `F->ovector`, only 2 elements). If `oveccount > 2`, this reads beyond the `Fovector` array, causing an out-of-bounds read!

Wait, but this is the newer version of PCRE2 (10.40+). Let me check the version and understand the frame_size calculation. The `frame_size` includes the ovector space. Let me look at how frame_size is calculated.
